title: Filter joined data
prompt: List patient_id and hospital name for patients at for-profit hospitals only.
starterSql:
SELECT patients.patient_id, hospitals.name
FROM patients
JOIN hospitals ON patients.hospital_id = hospitals.hospital_id
hints: WHERE after JOIN filters the combined result.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT patients.patient_id, hospitals.name FROM patients JOIN hospitals ON patients.hospital_id = hospitals.hospital_id WHERE hospitals.org_type = 'for_profit'
